issuer: self-referential boundary process v1, authority derives solely from inclusion in _truth/receipts/index.json, no external steward
scope: declares the boundary of this system and its public proof rules
proof_rules: Canonical claims must be indexed in _truth/receipts/index.json.
Canonical receipts must be content-addressed by sha256.
Canonical receipts require valid signatures satisfying the keyset published in epoch-0.
Working claims are syntactically invalid for index.json and must be rejected by any canonical validator.
Visual art and narrative summaries are public presentation surfaces, not truth surfaces.
Epoch closure requires a threshold signature over the final root before freeze.

signature_strategy.indexing_precondition: publish epoch-0 keyset and attach valid signatures satisfying that keyset
